verdict.rationale: Receipt issuance is a fair axis for an in-person payments product, so it applies. The evidence pack never documents printed, email, or SMS receipt generation, or compliance with card-network receipt requirements. The only receipt mention is 'Tipping on the receipt', which is a tipping option rather than a receipt-issuance capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements
